storyNotes: 36 official general anchorages (33 CFR 110.155) in the Upper/Lower Bay, Hudson and Raritan Bay.
21 maintained channels dissolved by fairway name (Ambrose, Anchorage, Kill Van Kull, Arthur Kill, Newark Bay ...).
Terminal, bridge, ferry-lane and tourist-area polygons are approximate and flagged "(approx.)" in their names.
